adapters.exportDuty: Leaves with us: every object — the nightly off-vendor export of D1 and KV, gzipped JSON lines that nothing but our own script parses, plus its manifests. Export: COPY WITH RCLONE — R2 speaks the S3 API, so `rclone copy` from the R2 remote to any S3-compatible remote moves the bucket today, and Box B already pulls every night's objects off-vendor. Cannot move: nothing.

c8Seam.why: tooling/capability-register.json records Cloudflare's C-8 seam as the client's ConfigTransport (the config the apps fetch). R2 is one of several Cloudflare surfaces now behind its own port; the vendor's C-8 row is re-seated when its last surface, D1, is ported.

adapters.exportDuty: THE EXIT, DECLARED AND NOT BUILT. An ObjectStore over the S3 API (SigV4-signed fetch) would serve any S3-compatible store — R2 itself through its S3 endpoint included. It is not built because there is no second store to point it at; until one is chosen the exit is `rclone copy` between the two remotes, which needs no code here. Vendor null: no store has been chosen.
A test double: a Map of byte arrays that lives for one test. Nothing to export.

pending.case: the whole suite against the real binding: every Worker suite runs on Node under plain vitest (services/*/vitest.config.ts), not on workerd — no Miniflare, no @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers — so the binding never meets the suite in CI; the structural proof is tsc over ports/adapters/cloudflare.ts

_why: BACKUPS_R2 is declared as ObjectStore in services/platform's `interface Env`, and its one writer — the nightly export, services/platform/src/backup/index.ts (BackupEnv) — takes an ObjectStore. An R2Bucket satisfies it STRUCTURALLY; cloudflareR2 is the identity, kept as the compile-time proof. assert-ports limb 12 refuses an R2Bucket (or R2Objects) type anywhere else under services/*/src.

L2 claimed, L2 target: selected by environment, no caller imports an adapter, one live adapter. The `s3` adapter is DRAFT on purpose — the exit is already open through rclone, so building it before a second store exists would be code with no subject.
The conformance suite runs against the memory fake; against the bucket it is PENDING, because no Worker suite runs on workerd.
